global_caveat: arXiv has no official trending chart; this ordering is inferred from checkable Hugging Face upvotes and Hacker News points, not a universal popularity measure, and recent citation evidence is limited.

sections.title: Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence
sections.abstract: The authors introduce a 35B-parameter medical multimodal model with 3B active parameters, trained through staged data curation and progressive supervised and reinforcement-learning stages, and report results across 238 clinical tasks.
sections.claimed_contribution: The authors report a 58.26% average score on 31 public multimodal benchmarks and describe remaining gaps in complex medical reasoning and multi-step clinical workflows.
sections.unique_caveat: The abstract explicitly says complex medical reasoning and multi-step clinical workflows remain substantial challenges; the reported public-benchmark average covers 31 of the 238 total tasks.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: 81 Hugging Face Papers upvotes at the 2026-11-28 snapshot, the highest count among the selected entries; cumulative total, not a window gain.

sections.title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
sections.abstract: MoLT uses key-value memory across repeated Transformer loops and introduces a U-shaped variant intended to balance model quality, token efficiency, and decoding cost.
sections.claimed_contribution: In author-reported experiments, U-MoLT achieves 1.7× validation cross-entropy token efficiency at 700M parameters and similar latency to non-looped OLMo3 in a small-model decoding test.
sections.unique_caveat: The results are bounded by the reported 700M/1.5B dense and 3B MoE pretraining experiments, one 0.8B continued-pretraining backbone, and a small-model latency test.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: 74 Hugging Face Papers upvotes at the 2026-11-28 snapshot; cumulative count, not a period gain. Public code repository also available.

sections.title: VibeVideoAgent: Closing the Perceptual Loop for Code-Driven Video Generation
sections.abstract: VibeVideoAgent lets coding agents inspect short previews of rendered video and audio during production, returning grounded findings that guide iterative edits without filling the coder’s context with raw media.
sections.claimed_contribution: On 239 VibeVideoBench tasks, the authors report improved audiovisual quality for three tested coding-agent models under matched runtimes and a fixed perception model.
sections.unique_caveat: The evaluation uses a fixed perception model, and trajectory audits report a trade-off between code-edit granularity, rubric compliance, and perceptual quality.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: 58 Hugging Face Papers upvotes at the 2026-11-28 snapshot; cumulative total, not a window gain.

sections.title: Improving and Expanding Video Editing Capabilities Without Videos
sections.abstract: Image-to-Video Transfer uses an image editor to guide a pretrained video editor using single images, aiming to expand video-editing capabilities without collecting paired edited videos.
sections.claimed_contribution: Across three video editors, the authors report improved performance on OpenVE-Bench and their extended OpenVE++ suite, which adds four video-editing tasks.
sections.unique_caveat: The abstract reports tests on three video editors and two related benchmarks; it does not establish generalization to other editing systems or task distributions.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: 46 Hugging Face Papers upvotes at the 2026-11-28 snapshot; cumulative count, not a window gain.

sections.title: DocSEAM: Bidirectional Cross-Page Encoding for Multi-Page Document Understanding
sections.abstract: DocSEAM enriches each document page’s visual tokens with information from adjacent pages using anchored masked attention, while keeping the visual token count unchanged.
sections.claimed_contribution: The authors report state-of-the-art results among evaluated open-weight models up to 10B parameters on five multi-page document VQA benchmarks, with reduced re-pagination sensitivity and improved cross-page span localization.
sections.unique_caveat: The reported comparison is limited to a 9B model, the tested open-weight systems up to 10B parameters, and five multi-page VQA benchmarks.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: 28 Hugging Face Papers upvotes at the 2026-11-28 snapshot; cumulative total, not a window gain.

sections.title: HOG-WAM: Improving Visual Robustness through Future Gradient Prediction
sections.abstract: HOG-WAM adds training-only future histogram-of-oriented-gradients prediction to a world-action model to improve the visual representations used for robot control under observation corruption.
sections.claimed_contribution: The authors report higher success than compared policies under four controlled observation corruptions, with additional results on LIBERO Plus and four Franka tasks.
sections.unique_caveat: Evidence is bounded by the listed corruption settings, LIBERO Plus, and four Franka tasks; the abstract does not establish robustness across broader sensors, robots, or deployment conditions.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: 23 Hugging Face Papers upvotes at the 2026-11-28 snapshot; cumulative count, not a window gain.

sections.title: Looped Models are Fast Multi-Token Predictors
sections.abstract: Floodgates adapts shallow loops in looped language models to draft multiple future tokens in parallel, enabling self-speculative decoding that verifies with deeper computation.
sections.claimed_contribution: Across seven models and five benchmarks, the authors report that Floodgates is the fastest lossless decoding method in most tested cases, with up to 7.5× acceleration.
sections.unique_caveat: The speedup claim is scoped to the evaluated models, benchmarks, batch sizes, and decoding settings; the maximum reported acceleration is not an across-the-board result.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Hacker News discussion item 50657370 received 13 points and 0 comments. HN points are not numerically comparable to Hugging Face upvotes; listed separately after the HF-ranked entries.
